synthesis:draft.headline: VIC1 five-minute RRP reached -504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: Minimum five-minute RRP in the window was -504.6525 $/MWh (interval end 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST).
The extreme negative price was part of a negative episode of 2 five-minute intervals ending 2026-07-28T11:25:00Z.
There were 0 five-minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold of 300 $/MWh during the window.
Operational demand in the half-hour containing the price extreme (half-hour ending 2026-07-28T11:30:00Z) was 7491.0 MW; window maximum operational demand was 8131.0 MW.
A long negative-price episode occurred 2026-07-28T11:50:00Z to 2026-07-28T20:15:00Z whose peak five-minute sample was -45.57834 $/MWh.

possible_explanations.statement: The invoked automated constraint set described in the constraint notice [c1] might have been binding and produced counter-price flows that coincide with the negative RRP episode.

possible_explanations.statement: A surplus of offered supply or negative-priced offers from specific units might have coincided with low demand at the half-hour containing the extreme and produced counter-price intervals.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve 5-minute bids/offers and rebid logs and unit SCADA for the dispatch interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z to identify negative offers or rapid changes in unit output.

possible_explanations.statement: Participant non-conformance or battery dispatch behaviour, as illustrated by the non-conformance notice [c3] (for TRGBESS1 on 2026-07-27), could be a contributor and might be present in related units around the event.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check non-conformance notices, unit rebid logs and SCADA/AGC command records for battery and flexible plant around 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z.
